---
title: "Join, update, leave"
---

## Join

Fill in the [membership form](FORM_URL_TO_ADD). The form asks whether you want to appear on the public map, which details may be shown there, and whether you want to join the RDN mailing list.

New entries appear on the map once a curator has checked them. This usually takes a few days.

## Update your entry

After you submit, we email you a personal link. Open it to change your answers at any time. Changes appear on the map within about 10 minutes.

If you have lost the link, email [owen.petchey@uzh.ch](mailto:owen.petchey@uzh.ch).

## Leave

Open your personal link and choose **Leave the network** at the end of the form, then submit. We will:

- remove you from the public map;
- ask the mailing-list manager to unsubscribe you;
- delete your entry from our records.

You can also leave by emailing [owen.petchey@uzh.ch](mailto:owen.petchey@uzh.ch).
